description: List the labels applied to a media file's transcript, in transcript order, with the file's current transcriptRevision. Each item has mediaLabelId, labelIds and an anchor: startWord and endWord (inclusive word indices), exact (the labelled words), startInSec, endInSec, speakerIds and status. Status active means the same words; shifted means the transcript was edited and most of the words survived; needs_review means the words changed too much, so anchor holds a suggested range and lastResolved the last confirmed one (confirm or move it with update_media_label). Anyone who can open the file can read its labels.

status.description: Only labels with this anchor status
